about: Original short lines in the voice of young adults on Facebook and Messenger, written from the patterns in docs/FEED_REALISM.md. Not copied from any person. Draw, vary and mix; do not reuse one line twice on the same surface.

fields.kind: optional sub-kind: tool-share, tag, poster-reply, joke, long, placeholder (a stand-in for a photo, voice memo, link, sticker or system line)
fields.tone: dull, practical, tired, annoyed, excited, warm, nostalgic, deadpan, silly, vague, sad, awkward, hype
fields.flags: emoji, exclaim (has !; product copy rules do not apply to made-up people's posts, drop if the owner says so), caps, capitalised (starts with a capital, as phone autocorrect does), no-punctuation

names: Names and places are from the Eastfield cast in docs/FEED_SPEC.md and are made up. @tags assume Facebook's tag style.
